description: Customizations to merge into DEFAULT_FIELD_SCHEMA in field_schema_manager.py
instructions:
To make these changes permanent:
1. Add new fields to DEFAULT_FIELD_SCHEMA dict in field_schema_manager.py
2. Append new category values to the relevant FieldDefinition.category_values lists
3. Add new alias entries to the relevant FieldDefinition.aliases dicts
4. Apply field_overrides to the relevant FieldDefinition attributes
5. Delete resources/.field-customizations.json after merging
6. Restart the server
